title: vmsacars flight thresholds
description: The built artifacts/settings.json: the flight-phase and landing-analysis thresholds the client resolves once per flight. defaults applies to every aircraft; each override layers its values on top when its selector matches (class overrides first, then icao overrides, each in file order). Also used to validate src/settings/defaults.json (against #/definitions/values) and every src/settings/overrides/*.json (against #/definitions/override) at build time.

version.description: Document format version. The client rejects anything other than 1.

override.description: One override document. Needs at least one selector; values lists only the keys it changes.

icao.description: ICAO aircraft type designators this override applies to, matched case-insensitively.

class.description: Aircraft class this override applies to.

values.description: The complete threshold set. Every key is required here; this is the shape of defaults.

partialValues.description: Any subset of the threshold keys. Unknown keys are rejected so a typo cannot silently fall through to the default.

taxiInMaxKt.description: Ground speed (kt) below which the aircraft is considered to be taxiing in after landing.

takeoffRunwayKt.description: Ground speed (kt) that starts the takeoff roll when the aircraft is on a known runway.

takeoffAnywhereKt.description: Ground speed (kt) that starts the takeoff roll anywhere, runway known or not.

goAroundAglFt.description: Absolute AGL (ft) the aircraft must be below on approach before a climb can count as a go-around.

goAroundClimbGainFt.description: Height gained (ft) above the approach low point that declares a go-around.

goAroundGsKt.description: Minimum ground speed (kt) during the climb for it to count as a go-around.

goAroundVsFpm.description: Minimum vertical speed (fpm) during the climb for it to count as a go-around.

arrivalAirborneAglFt.description: AGL (ft) below which the arrival segment of a flight begins in landing analysis.

circuitLiftoffSeconds.description: Seconds the aircraft must stay airborne after a touchdown for the lift-off to count as a new circuit.

circuitLiftoffAglFt.description: AGL (ft) the aircraft must reach after a touchdown for the lift-off to count as a new circuit.

circuitStopKt.description: Ground speed (kt) below which a landing roll is considered stopped, ending the circuit.

circuitRollEnabled.description: Whether a re-acceleration on the runway (a touch-and-go roll) can start a new circuit. Off for helicopters.

circuitRollMinKt.description: Ground speed (kt) floor for a roll attempt. Kept above takeoffRunwayKt so an expedited runway exit after over-slowing does not qualify.

circuitRollAccelKt.description: Ground speed gain (kt) over circuitRollWindowSeconds that declares a roll attempt.

circuitRollWindowSeconds.description: Sim-clock window (s) over which circuitRollAccelKt is measured; needs at least three samples, and a gap over two seconds resets it.

circuitRollHeadingToleranceDeg.description: Heading drift (deg) allowed during the roll window for it to still count as a roll on the runway.

departureAfterReverserPenalty.description: Points taken off the landing category (0-100) when the aircraft departs again after reversers were used.

circuitLiftoffMinVsFpm.description: Mean vertical speed (fpm) over the circuitLiftoffSeconds window must be at or above this for a lift-off to confirm. Stops a fall off an obstacle (AGL rising while VS is deeply negative) from counting as a departure.

touchdownMaxRadioAltFt.description: An on-ground sample with a valid radio altitude above this (ft) and no gear contact is not a touchdown. Rejects building or obstacle strikes the sim reports as ground contact. Unknown radio altitude or gear data always counts as plausible.

contactLandedSec.description: Empirical. Contact held this long (s) means the aircraft is on the ground.

airborneDwellSec.description: Empirical. On-ground false this long (s), with the gain, enters Airborne. Measured from the lift-off edge to the re-contact edge.

airborneGainFt.description: Empirical. Radio-altitude gain (ft) over the ground baseline needed together with the dwell.

airborneGainTimeoutSec.description: On-ground false this long (s) enters Airborne whatever the gain (sloped runway, unusable radio altitude).

bounceMinGainFt.description: Empirical. A span after touchdown that rises at least this much (ft) is a bounce, not a rollout hop.

bounceMinAirborneSec.description: Empirical. A span after touchdown airborne at least this long (s) is a bounce, not a rollout hop.

bounceMaxSec.description: Empirical. A span this long (s) without a departure is an extended float; the ground held this long closes bounce attribution.

holdSec.description: Touchdown values (rate, g, wheels) become final this long (s) after the contact. Equals the touchdown-g window.

sinkRateWindowSec.description: Empirical. Touchdown sink rate is the mean vertical speed over this window (s) ending at the last airborne sample before contact.

oneWheelSec.description: Empirical. One main wheel stable-down this long (s) before the other marks a one-wheel touchdown.

heliLiftoffSec.description: Helicopter departure: airborne at least this long (s).

heliLiftoffAglFt.description: Helicopter departure: at least this much gain (ft) over the ground baseline.

lowFullRateMaxSec.description: Capture policy: full-rate recording below 2,000 ft AGL lasts at most this long (s) per low leg, then drops to 4 Hz.
